definition: extremely tired with no energy left
description: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

taps.phrase: to lie motionless in the foam

de.answer: Der erschöpfte Mann liegt im Schaum.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: El hombre agotado está tumbado en la espuma.
phrases: estar tumbado inmóvil en la espuma
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?
